podcast.body: Recorded by The Wailers in 1967, this song quickly became a classic within the reggae canon and was later covered by Johnny Nash, appearing on his 1972 album "I Can See Clearly Now." "And they recorded what is now considered a classic in the reggae canon, Stir It Up in 1967."

podcast.body: This song by Bob Marley features the distinct sound of a Mini-Moog synthesizer. The presence of the Mini-Moog contributes to the song's texture and demonstrates the instrument's broad application across genres. "If you listen to Bob Marley's Stirred Up, you'll hear a Mini-Mog."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
